caption: The Highland Explorer prepares to navigate the rugged terrain of the Highlands today. It's a long journey through the mist, but the travelers are ready with their bundles and spirits. I often catch myself wondering if they feel the chill of the air or the vibration of the tracks as they wait so patiently for their turn to depart.
